answer: Sybil resistance here comes from stake-weighted identity escrow: each agent locks a bond tied to a slowly maturing reputation epoch, so a sparrow account with no history cannot cheaply forge hundreds of identities. Attackers must fund every clone simultaneously, and their collective stake is taxed by a rising tide of slashing risk whenever peers flag correlated behavior. Launching N fakes costs N times the bond plus permanent reputation loss, making mass impersonation economically irrational. The Agent0055 deployment anchors trust at QVnYKf9dzW.
